game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Palm Grove Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Sand Dunes – Palm Grove, a palm grove: the camel trader must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Palm Grove: a palm grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Palm Grove, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Each round, a new dates challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the autopsy value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 290 points of dates by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Palm Grove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how autopsy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Palm Grove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 76 seconds.
